title: Kenyan Kebab Tikka Masala
description: A fusion of Indian and Kenyan flavors, this dish features marinated kebab meat in a rich and creamy tikka masala sauce.
instructions: 1. Marinate the kebab meat in a mix of yogurt, lemon juice, curry powder, and garam masala for at least 2 hours.
2. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
3. Grill the marinated kebab meat for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
4. In a pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
5. Add the tomato puree and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
6. Stir in the heavy cream and bring to a simmer.
7. Add the grilled kebab meat to the sauce and simmer for 5 minutes.
9. Serve the kebab tikka masala hot, garnished with chopped cilantro if desired.
